d: Presenting a very special episode of The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra. In our latest episode, Anshu Gupta, an Indian entrepreneur who founded the Non-Governmental Organization Goonj. Goonj aims to provide the basic need of cloth to the poor, but they do not believe in doing it as charity. They give it as currency to the villagers for improving their own conditions.
